summary: Crystal Root is the metaphysical lattice beneath Underfoot, where divine crystal veins carry Brell’s resonance. These roots extend into other planes, anchoring Underfoot to the cosmic foundation.
history: Crystal Root formed when Brell infused raw stone with divine resonance.
Crystal veins grew outward, connecting Underfoot to other planes.
Root‑born guardians emerged to protect the metaphysical lattice.
Mortals first reached Crystal Root through planar fissures.
